messages:
Morgan (eng-security): Auditor requested a bundled deliverable for SOC2 evidence: RBAC changes (service accounts) for Jan 2026, KMS rotation proof for alias redwood-prod-enc, and the vuln triage/incident timeline for CVE-2026-AB12. Can we compile and stamp chain-of-custody?

Sara (platform): I can assemble the RBAC artifacts. Will include PRs, approval comments, and deployment timestamps. quick list: PR #4243, PR #4301, infra-ansible changelog. Putting export on S3.

Chris (infra): KMS rotation bundle is already archived. Path: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/rotations/2026-02-01-redwood-prod-enc.tar.gz. It contains rotation-manifest.json, kms-cloudtrail-logs.jsonl (signed), and key-rotation-approvals.pdf (signed by sara@redwood).

Lee (oncall): I have the incident timeline for the vuln triage (incident-2026-02-14). Will include PagerDuty timeline, oncall notes, and postmortem draft. Slack bridge logs need redaction for emails.

Auditor (external): Thanks. A few clarifying asks: 1) For RBAC, we need proof of least privilege review (who reviewed + timestamp). 2) For KMS, we need CloudTrail events showing Decrypt/GenerateDataKey usage around rotation window. 3) For the incident, include any elevated-priv access during mitigation and the remediation sign-off.

Morgan (eng-security): Noted. For 1) Sara — can you add reviewer names and approval timestamps? For 2) Chris — can you add the CloudTrail query and export. For 3) Lee — confirm if any emergency service-account escalation happened and include authorizations.

Sara (platform): Added reviewer details to the RBAC pack: reviewers = ["Sara (platform)", "Morgan (eng-security)", "Dana (sec-ops)"] with timestamps in rbacs-review.csv. I also added the approval Jira link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2026-102

Chris (infra): CloudTrail export command I used: 
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=alias/redwood-prod-enc --start-time 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-02T00:00:00Z --output json > kms-cloudtrail-logs.jsonl
```
This output is in the rotation tarball. Key events included: DisableKeyRotation, RotateKey, CreateGrant, RevokeGrant.

Lee (oncall): Incident artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/2026-02-14-incident-2026-AB12.tar.gz. Contains pagerduty-export.json, slack-bridge-logs.txt (redacted), mitigation-runbook.md, and approval-signoffs.pdf. No emergency service-account escalations required — escalation was via existing runbook roles.

Auditor (external): Good. Please also provide a short chain-of-custody manifest listing when each artifact was packaged, who packaged it, and the checksum.

Sara (platform): I generated checksums and manifest: evidence-manifest-6123456789.json (sha256 sums). Uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/manifests/evidence-manifest-6123456789.json

Morgan (eng-security): I'll produce a short cover note that maps each artifact to SOC2 controls: CC6.1 (access controls), CC7.2 (encryption key management), and CC9.3 (incident response). Drafting now and will attach to the bundle.

audit-bot: Automated export complete. Bundle: s3://redwood-evidence/bundles/6123456789-soc2-bundle.tar.gz (size: 24MB). Signed by: morgan@redwood.sig

Auditor (external): Quick Q: who approved the RBAC PRs in prod? We need explicit prod-approval step proof.

Sara (platform): PR #4243 had prod-approval comment by sarah.lead@redwood on 2026-01-28T15:02Z. I've screenshot and included approval email forwarded to approvals.pdf.

Chris (infra): Also included the CI/CD deploy logs (circleci job 9876) showing the exact commit and timestamp deployed to prod. Linked in deploy-logs/deploy-9876.txt inside the bundle.

Lee (oncall): For the incident sign-off, postmortem final sign-off by sec-ops and product on 2026-02-18. Included in postmortem/final-signoff.pdf.

Auditor (external): That's perfect. Last thing — please provide a short explanation of how RBAC changes are tested before prod (smoke tests, role-review workflow).

Morgan (eng-security): Short explainer added to the cover note: RBAC change workflow = PR + automated iam-lint + staging smoke test (role-simulation) + manual review by platform/security (stated reviewers) + prod-approval comment. Smoke test artifacts: smoke/role-sim-report-4243.json included.

Sara (platform): Will we gate delivery with a single ZIP for the auditor? I can repackage everything and share a presigned link with 7-day expiry.

Auditor (external): Yes, please. Presigned link with manifest and checksums is sufficient.

Chris (infra): Created presigned link: https://s3.redwood.example/presigned/6123456789-bundle?t=7d (shared via secure email).

Morgan (eng-security): Awesome — closing loop. Action items: (Sara) confirm RBAC screenshots included, (Chris) ensure CloudTrail extracts include requestId correlation, (Lee) finalize postmortem signoff PDF. Target: today EOD.

Sara (platform): Confirmed.

Chris (infra): I'll add requestId mapping to cloudtrail export.

Lee (oncall): Postmortem signoff uploaded.

Auditor (external): Received bundle and manifest. Thank you, team. 

Morgan (eng-security): Thank you all :thumbsup:
